title: Hierarchical Adaptive Normalization: A Placement-Conditioned Cascade for Robust Wearable Activity Recognition

contributions.purpose: 缓解可穿戴HAR中传感器放置/朝向变化导致的性能退化
contributions.mechanism: 两阶段级联:重力物理朝向校正+信号方差推断放置上下文,再接placement-conditioned自适应BatchNorm
contributions.evaluation: 宏F1较静态与UDA基线有改进(定性,未给对比数值),延迟/内存开销极小
contributions.source_quote: Our contributions include integrating lightweight physics-based correction with context-aware normalization, designing a real-time stability gate, and performing extensive empirical evaluations and ablation studies.

contributions.purpose: 防止在不稳定动态期(如跌倒/高冲击)误导自适应
contributions.mechanism: 基于归一化输入范数的实时稳定门,范数低于阈值τ时抑制自适应更新
contributions.evaluation: 定性:稳定门有效抑制信号突变期的自适应,保持性能(无数值)
contributions.source_quote: A stability gate is computed based on the norm of the normalized input; if the norm is below a threshold, adaptive updates are suppressed to avoid misleading adaptation during unstable events.

contributions.purpose: 揭示自适应机制对CNN kernel size敏感这一实证发现
contributions.mechanism: 跨kernel size {1,3,5,7}的超参与消融实验(Static/Gravity-Only/Naive/Conditioned/Full Cascade)
contributions.evaluation: kernel 5/7最优,训练F1约0.43、验证F1约0.49;Full Cascade一致提升宏F1且开销可忽略
contributions.source_quote: kernel sizes 5 and 7 yielded final training F1-scores around 0.43 and validation F1-scores near 0.49.

self_declared_provenance.quote: our method blends a lightweight physics-based correction with adaptive normalization inspired by calibration-free test-time adaptation (Wimpff et al., 2023) to achieve efficient and robust HAR in real-world scenarios.
